source_notes.note: The local source is arXiv:1611.07725v2, dated 14 April 2017. The PDF SHA-256 is recorded in paper.yaml and manifest.json. The CVPR 2017 venue and full author list were checked against the CVF Open Access record.

Problem definition, class-incremental criteria, model architecture, prototype classifier, representation learning, and exemplar management are covered in the extracted text with physical page boundaries.
The paper contains five algorithm blocks. They are included in the W1 inventory as ALGORITHM visuals and should be compared with the prose before they are used to support claims.
Main experimental plots and the ablation/NCM table are inventoried. Any reused number must remain tied to its dataset, class-batch protocol, metric, and comparison described in the paper.
Appendix confusion matrices cover 1000 iILSVRC classes presented in batches of 100. Plots and axes were visually checked; the dense matrix values are not recoverable from the prose extraction alone.
This is an inventory only. No figure has been approved for public reuse; selected originals, attribution, and reuse-rights evidence remain W3 decisions.
